verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can put files into Muse's VM, where Muse can inspect and work with them, and that Muse has its own file system and terminal for writing code and building tools. That implies it could ingest and process user files, but no source explicitly describes uploading documents, spreadsheets or PDFs for analysis. Missing for 10: explicit documented upload of documents/spreadsheets/PDFs, a described document-analysis capability, any evidence on analysis accuracy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
